products.name: Neel Gaj – Hand Block Printed Pure Maheshwari Silk Saree
products.wash_care: Dry clean recommended. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
products.description: A beautiful blend of traditional artistry and timeless elegance. Delicate ivory floral motifs on a rich royal blue base, complemented by intricate geometric patterns, traditional elephant motifs and botanical detailing on the statement pallu. Contrasting borders complete this elegant Maheshwari silk saree.
